llama_cpp.load_mode_note: Pinned upstream removed --no-mmap; --load-mode none is its documented non-mmap equivalent. Default comparison uses auto. Lazy loading and automatic fit are disabled to keep measured residency and contexts explicit.

fp8_text_encoder.name: torchao
fp8_text_encoder.recipe: torchao.quantization.quantize_(FLUX text_encoder, Float8WeightOnlyConfig(set_inductor_config=False)); BF16 transformer and activations unchanged
fp8_text_encoder.output_mode: Intermediate hidden states through the original base encoder; full original weights retained, unused language-logit projection not executed

cache_limit_note: CPU prompt snapshot cache disabled on GB10; native per-slot GPU KV prompt reuse remains enabled. Context floor remains 16k per slot, with 2 lead slots and 3 worker slots.

python_headers.delivery: Extract locally with dpkg-deb; never install into the host OS

pytorch.license: BSD-3-Clause core; bundled permissive licenses retained in installed distribution

runtime_memory_policy.global_swap: enabled and monitored without excluding pages
